decisions_made.decision: Use bundled vietnam_locations.json (from https://www3.evcs.vn/l.json) in app assets
decisions_made.reason: Lightweight (26KB), covers all 63 provinces and ~700 districts with precomputed lat/lng centroids, eliminates external HTTP calls and Cloudflare bot protection issues, enables 100% offline usage.

decisions_made.decision: Three-tab bottom navigation with Favorites in the center
decisions_made.reason: User requirement: Tab 1 Nearby, Tab 2 Favorites (Center), Tab 3 Route (Beside Favorites).
Prevents recommending charging stations on the opposite side of dual-carriageway expressways where U-turns are illegal or require tens of kilometers.

decisions_made.decision: DC power tiering: >=60kW prioritized -> 30kW fallback -> exclude AC 11kW
decisions_made.reason: Provides fast travel charging times and prevents slow AC charging stops on long trips.

decisions_made.decision: One test per phase verification protocol
decisions_made.reason: Ensures isolated, verifiable, and regression-free incremental implementation.
